about_short_description.short_description: Tendo is a social commerce platform that enables anyone to start an online shop with zero capital.

product.name: Tendo Reseller Platform
product.description: A platform that allows individuals to start an online business by reselling products without upfront capital, handling order placement, delivery, and profit collection.

product.name: Tendo Supplier Service
product.description: A service for suppliers to list their products at wholesale prices on Tendo, leveraging the reseller network to increase sales without handling deliveries or incurring listing costs.

product.name: Fulfilled By Tendo (FBT)
product.description: A program where Tendo handles import, warehousing, marketing, sales, and delivery of products sourced from global suppliers, allowing sellers to focus on selecting products and earning profits.

product.name: Tendo Influencer Program
product.description: A program enabling content creators to create personalized online stores, share product links, and earn commissions on sales without managing inventory or delivery.
